stages.title: Neighbours
stages.summary: Saying hello and sorting things out

sentences.en: We've just arrived at the flat.
What's the code for the key box?
sentences.es: ¿Cuál es el código de la caja de llaves?
sentences.pt: Qual é o código da caixa das chaves?

sentences.en: Which floor is it on?
The door won't open.
Is there a lift in the building?
Where do we leave the keys when we go?
sentences.pt: Onde deixamos as chaves quando sairmos?

sentences.en: How does the washing machine work?
sentences.pt: Como funciona a máquina de lavar?

sentences.en: Where is the fuse box?
The heating isn't on.
Is there an iron?
Where do we put the rubbish?
Is the tap water OK to drink?
sentences.es: ¿Se puede beber el agua del grifo?
sentences.pt: Pode-se beber a água da torneira?

sentences.en: Hi, we're staying in flat 3B.
sentences.es: Hola, estamos en el tercero B.

sentences.en: Sorry about the noise last night.
sentences.es: Perdone por el ruido de anoche.
sentences.pt: Desculpe o barulho de ontem à noite.

sentences.en: Could you turn the music down?
Do you know when the rubbish is collected?
sentences.pt: Sabe quando é que recolhem o lixo?

sentences.en: Is there a supermarket around here?
Have a nice day!
Do we need to strip the beds?
We've taken the rubbish out.
sentences.pt: Já pusemos o lixo lá fora.

sentences.en: We broke a glass, sorry.
sentences.es: Hemos roto un vaso, lo siento.

sentences.en: When will we get the deposit back?
sentences.pt: Quando é que nos devolvem a caução?

sentences.en: Everything was very clean.
We'll leave a good review.

passages.text: La caja de llaves está a la derecha del portal; el código es el año en que nací, mil novecientos setenta y ocho. Es un tercero sin ascensor, lo siento. Al irse, dejen las llaves en la mesa y cierren de golpe.
passages.en: The key box is to the right of the building door; the code is the year I was born, nineteen seventy-eight. It's a third floor without a lift, sorry. When you leave, put the keys on the table and pull the door shut.
passages.question: What's the key box code?

passages.text: A caixa das chaves está à direita da porta do prédio; o código é o ano em que nasci, mil novecentos e setenta e oito. É um terceiro andar sem elevador, desculpem. Quando saírem, deixem as chaves na mesa e batam a porta.
passages.en: The key box is to the right of the building door; the code is the year I was born, nineteen seventy-eight. It's a third floor without a lift, sorry. When you leave, put the keys on the table and pull the door shut.
passages.question: What's the key box code?

passages.text: La lavadora tarda una hora y media; el programa corto es el número cuatro. La calefacción se enciende con el mando que está en el cajón de la cocina. El agua del grifo se puede beber sin problema.
passages.en: The washing machine takes an hour and a half; the short programme is number four. The heating is turned on with the remote in the kitchen drawer. Tap water is fine to drink.
passages.question: How do you turn on the heating?
passages.answer: With the remote in the kitchen drawer.

passages.text: A máquina de lavar demora hora e meia; o programa curto é o número quatro. O aquecimento liga-se com o comando que está na gaveta da cozinha. A água da torneira pode-se beber sem problema.
passages.en: The washing machine takes an hour and a half; the short programme is number four. The heating is turned on with the remote in the kitchen drawer. Tap water is fine to drink.
passages.question: How do you turn on the heating?
passages.answer: With the remote in the kitchen drawer.

passages.text: La basura se baja por la noche, a partir de las ocho, a los contenedores de la esquina. El vidrio va en el verde. Y por favor, después de las once, nada de ruido, que aquí vive gente mayor.
passages.en: Rubbish goes down in the evening, from eight, to the bins on the corner. Glass goes in the green one. And please, no noise after eleven; older people live here.
passages.question: When should you take the rubbish out?

passages.text: O lixo deita-se à noite, a partir das oito, nos contentores da esquina. O vidro vai para o verde. E por favor, depois das onze, nada de barulho, que aqui vivem pessoas idosas.
passages.en: Rubbish goes down in the evening, from eight, to the bins on the corner. Glass goes in the green one. And please, no noise after eleven; older people live here.
passages.question: When should you take the rubbish out?

passages.text: Antes de irse, dejen las sábanas y las toallas en el baño y saquen la basura. La fianza se devuelve en una semana, cuando la limpiadora revise el piso. Un vaso roto no es problema.
passages.en: Before you leave, put the sheets and towels in the bathroom and take the rubbish out. The deposit is returned within a week, once the cleaner has checked the flat. A broken glass is no problem.
passages.question: When do you get the deposit back?
passages.answer: Within a week, after the cleaner checks.
wrong: Minus the cost of the broken glass.

passages.text: Antes de saírem, deixem os lençóis e as toalhas na casa de banho e ponham o lixo lá fora. A caução é devolvida dentro de uma semana, depois de a senhora da limpeza ver o apartamento. Um copo partido não é problema.
passages.en: Before you leave, put the sheets and towels in the bathroom and take the rubbish out. The deposit is returned within a week, once the cleaner has checked the flat. A broken glass is no problem.
passages.question: When do you get the deposit back?
passages.answer: Within a week, after the cleaner checks.
wrong: Minus the cost of the broken glass.
